name: Investment Advisory
headline:
Better opportunities.
Better decisions.
summary: We help private investors, family offices and entrepreneurs identify and evaluate investment opportunities worth their capital.
lead: We help private investors, family offices and entrepreneurs find, evaluate and structure investment opportunities across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, Uzbekistan and selected international markets — with the rigour of an investor, not the incentives of a broker.

seo.title: Investment Advisory in Saudi Arabia, the GCC & Uzbekistan
seo.description: Investment advisory for family offices, private investors and entrepreneurs: opportunity sourcing, commercial due diligence, investment theses and cross-border structuring across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and Uzbekistan.

blocks.label: What we do
blocks.title: From first conversation to committed capital.

items.title: Opportunity sourcing
items.text: We identify opportunities through founders, operators, investors and local partners — many of which never reach a public process.

items.title: Commercial due diligence
items.text: We test the market, the business model, the competitive position and the management team before capital is committed.

items.title: Investment thesis
items.text: We articulate why an opportunity is attractive, what has to be true for it to work and what would change the view.

items.title: Financial & operational assessment
items.text: We review the numbers behind the story: unit economics, cost structure, cash generation and operating capacity.

items.title: Risk analysis
items.text: We map commercial, market, partner and execution risks — and what can realistically be done about each.

items.title: Structuring & co-investment
items.text: We define the investment structure and, where appropriate, assemble co-investors — coordinating legal and tax work with qualified counsel.

items.title: Market research
items.text: We size markets, map competitors and speak to customers so decisions rest on evidence rather than assumptions.

items.title: Portfolio strategy
items.text: We help family offices and investors shape where they want exposure — by market, sector and type of participation.

blocks.label: How a mandate runs
blocks.title: A disciplined process. A small number of decisions that matter.

items.name: Source
items.text: Opportunities from our network and yours, screened against your mandate.

items.name: Screen
items.text: A first view on fit, attractiveness and obvious deal-breakers.

items.name: Evaluate
items.text: Commercial, financial and operational due diligence.

items.name: Structure
items.text: Investment structure, terms and partners, with qualified counsel.

items.name: Execute
items.text: Negotiation support, closing coordination and onboarding.

items.name: Support
items.text: Post-investment value creation, reporting and follow-on decisions.

blocks.text: We evaluate opportunities the way an investor would — and say so when one doesn’t hold up.

items.title: Family offices
items.text: Direct investments and strategic projects outside the core business.

items.title: Private investors
items.text: Deal sourcing, independent analysis and co-investment access.

items.title: Investment companies
items.text: Market intelligence, commercial due diligence and local execution.

items.text: Preparing a business for capital and finding the right investor.

items.text: Which market, which model, which partner and which sequence — before capital is committed.

items.title: Business model analysis
items.text: How value is created and captured today, and where the model is fragile or under-monetised.

items.title: Commercial due diligence
items.text: An independent view of a business’s market position before an acquisition, partnership or investment.

items.title: Operating model design
items.text: Structure, processes, governance and systems aligned to the strategy rather than to history.

items.title: Business optimisation
items.text: Finding the cost, time and complexity that do not create value — and removing them.

items.title: Strategic planning
items.text: Multi-year plans with clear priorities, owners, milestones and the metrics that matter.

Modern systems.
Lighter operations.

Not create more of it.

name: AI Business Transformation
headline:
AI where it creates
measurable value.
summary: We help organisations use AI to reduce costs, automate work and make better decisions — where it creates measurable value.
lead: We treat AI as an operating tool, not a headline. We find the processes where it reduces cost, saves time or improves decisions — then pilot, implement, measure and scale.

seo.title: AI Consulting & AI Transformation in Saudi Arabia and the GCC
seo.description: Practical AI consulting in Saudi Arabia, the GCC and Uzbekistan: AI audits, strategy, pilots, AI agents, automation, business intelligence and governance — focused on measurable value.

blocks.label: AI services
blocks.title: Put AI where it actually matters.

items.title: AI audit
items.text: Analyse the existing business and identify where AI creates value.

items.title: AI strategy
items.text: Define where AI should be introduced — and where it should not.

items.title: AI pilots
items.text: Rapidly test high-value use cases against a clear success measure.

items.title: AI implementation
items.text: Integrate AI into existing systems and day-to-day workflows.

items.title: AI agents
items.text: Task-specific agents for sales, marketing, research, HR, support, operations and management.

items.title: AI automation
items.text: Automate repetitive workflows end to end, with people kept in control.

items.title: AI intelligence
items.text: Turn business data into information management can act on.

items.title: AI governance
items.text: Security, access, data and responsible-use principles from the start.

items.name: Discover
items.text: Workshops and process reviews to collect candidate use cases.

items.name: Assess
items.text: Rank by value, feasibility, data readiness and risk.

items.name: Pilot
items.text: A time-boxed test on real work with a measurable target.

items.name: Implement
items.text: Integrate into systems, train teams, set up monitoring.

items.name: Scale
items.text: Roll out across functions and entities; retire what does not perform.

blocks.text: Where AI is not the right answer, we say so. Most value comes from a handful of well-chosen use cases, implemented properly.
